svg.title: Subpool console redesign
svg.desc: Four desktop administration screens for Overview, Accounts, Pools, and API Keys, using the Gesta console visual language.

g.text: Four implementation-ready desktop views aligned with the Gesta console shell.
Capacity, assignments, and usage across every connected Codex subscription.
Assigned API keys over each account limit
Input and output tokens · last 14 days
Usage totals only · request content is never stored
Connect subscriptions, set API-key capacity, and monitor OAuth health.
Capacity limits the number of API keys assigned to each account.
Group accounts, constrain models, and keep every employee key pinned to one upstream account.
Model policy and account capacity by routing group
Separate account capacity by team or workload.
Engineering · fixed assignment after first request
Issue one key per employee, inspect its fixed account assignment, and track token totals.
Keys are shown once at creation; stored records remain masked.
Design tokens and responsive behavior are documented in subpool/DESIGN.md
GESTA VISUAL LANGUAGE · SUBPOOL DOMAIN MODEL
